scope: Read-only normative requirements/C-model divergence review to guide separately staged stateful RTL; source inspection only

findings.required: Accept replaces configuration atomically, increments real generation/stores CRC and clears session; require a new SYNC. Every rejected CONFIGURE clears config_valid, required_mask and both alarm masks but preserves last accepted generation/CRC/hash for diagnosis. Failed preconditions must not leave an older usable configuration.
findings.observed: Model retains session after acceptance, models generation as config_valid in feedback, clears only alarm_trip_mask on semantic rejection and bypasses all configuration clearing for rejected state/sequence preconditions. Structural frame rejection latches LINK only.

findings.required: Require disarmed, IO disabled, actual qualification complete, no power-cycle fault and released inhibit. New nonzero session resets shared sequence and clearable latches, restarts faulted IOL1 epochs; never sets continuity.
findings.observed: Model checks disarmed/new session/no power-cycle fault only; it has no IO/qualification/inhibit/IOL1 provider state.

findings.required: Enforce actual tripping alarm, required encoder validity, motion-critical ports, both measured watchdog test passes since powerup/card change, qualified reset release consumed once, contactor off/STO expected/reset not held. Refusal must use the specified fault/event semantics.
findings.observed: Model ARM does not check selftest_ok or any external provider. configure_ok also does not prove current installed class/provider health.

findings.required: Select M or O, reject overlap, force every specified safe output/request while testing, record real external watchdog fall in 9.06-13.37ms, fault on early/late/no fall and wait actual recovery before ARM. Pass flags are independent and invalidated by powerup/motion-card change. PERMIT_OUT remains physically open.
findings.observed: Model sets one selftest_ok bit immediately, representing both feedback pass bits; it has no measured edge/window/recovery state.

findings.required: Stop new STEP starts, drain current configured high AND low spacing AND DIR hold, then lower motion request; preserve continuity only for a clean stop. Require actual OPI fall within10us after request drop; stuck path latches fault and refuses next ARM. Accepted with faults latched.
findings.observed: Model immediately clears armed_mask/rates, has no pulse-spacing/hold/drain state or OPI provider.

findings.required: Any fault disarm while armed clears continuity for every armed channel, including zero-rate channels; domain OPI interruptions apply the specified domain mask and disarm all. Reset/reconfiguration/installed-mask changes clear continuity.
findings.observed: Model latch clears only armed channels with nonzero rate; no domain OPI providers are modeled.

findings.required: Commit all12 rates plus complete output image atomically at accepted UPDATE; unmasked rates zero, clamps and IO validation; IO-disabled payload zero. Exact progress_m/progress_o and independent motion/IO watchdog feeds follow accepted opcode semantics.
findings.observed: Model updates rates only, IO_DISABLE only advances sequence, and other IO commands are unsupported. This is an explicit host-double scope limit, not a complete endpoint oracle.

findings.required: Implement exact5ms elapsed deadline and50tick progress pulses from actual accepted commands only; feedback/NOP never feed. External watchdog containment remains separate physical proof. Document start/deadline tick convention.
findings.observed: Model checks elapsed > WATCHDOG_TICKS, permits one extra tick at equality, and simulates timestamp updates rather than physical progress widths.

findings.required: One shared nonzero sequence across both CS; explicit no-wrap state guard and exhaust-before-new-session behavior. Sequence-zero read opcodes do not advance.
findings.observed: Model next_sequence uses uint32 last+1 without explicit exhaustion check, BUT the structural validator rejects stateful sequence0 and driver has exhaustion guard. This is a normative explicit RTL/test obligation, not evidence of externally accepted model wrap.

findings.required: Installed mask and ready/qualification/effective-permission fields must derive real current providers, including tamper/power-cycle latches; no fixed healthy fixture can confer actuator authority. Keep provider unknown/invalid explicit.
findings.observed: Model initializes installed8/12 and advertises qualification bit unconditionally; the host simulation scope cannot replace real hardware input qualification.
